note: Notes of the call with the CFO on 12 November

facts.statement: The CFO said the gross margin fell in 2025 because raw milk prices rose 18% during the drought.
Cedar buys milk from three cooperatives under contracts that fix volumes, not prices.
The CFO said Bluegate pays within 45 days.
Lakeside Distributors buys under a one-year contract, and three other distributors serve the same region.

decisions.decision: Lakeside Distributors gets no page and no checks of its own.
decisions.reason: It buys 14% of revenue and can be replaced: three other distributors serve the same region.

decisions.decision: Cedar is to propose how it will cover the euro loan before the concept note goes in.
decisions.reason: The loan is asked in euros and all revenue is in shillings.

questions.text: Please send the supply contracts with the three cooperatives.
